faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything couples ask before designing their crest.

items.question: What is a wedding crest?
items.answer: A wedding crest is an illustrated emblem that represents you as a couple — typically combining your initials or names with decorative elements like florals, laurels, or arches in your wedding style. It appears on invitations, signage, menus, and favors to unify your entire celebration.

items.question: What's the difference between a wedding crest and a monogram?
items.answer: A monogram is your initials arranged typographically (like 'E & J'). A wedding crest is a fuller emblem that surrounds your names or monogram with illustrated artwork — florals, wreaths, arches, or frames. Every crest you design here includes a standalone monogram too.

items.question: Can I try it before signing up?
items.answer: Yes! You can design and generate your first crest completely without an account — you'll see it with a light watermark. Create an account (free) to save your design, and unlock watermark-free high-resolution files with the Wedding Identity Pack.

items.question: How many designs do I get?
items.answer: Each generation produces three crest candidates to choose from. Free accounts can create one project with five total generations. The Wedding Identity Pack unlocks three regenerations and the full download kit.

items.question: What files do I get?
items.answer: The Wedding Identity Pack includes: your primary crest in SVG (standard and 3000px print-ready PNG-ready scale), a standalone monogram SVG, a simplified mark SVG, a black-and-white version, four print mockups, and a usage guide with your exact color codes and fonts.

items.question: Are the names and dates crisp?
items.answer: Yes — and this is what sets us apart. The AI illustrates only the artwork layer; all typography (your names, initials, and date) is composed programmatically in real fonts. So text is always pixel-perfect, never the wobbly lettering typical of AI images.

items.question: Can I use my own colors?
items.answer: Absolutely. Choose from seven curated wedding palettes or enter your own hex codes — perfect for matching existing stationery or brand colors. You can select up to three colors per crest.

items.question: Can I make changes after generating?
items.answer: Yes. Quick edits — reduce colors, remove a personal element, simplify the illustration — are one click. You can also change the typography pairing, layout, or name display anytime with instant preview, no regeneration needed.
